name: NanoSVG
reason: The primary memononen/nanosvg repository documents nsvgParseFromFile and uses a zlib license, but the official GitHub releases and tags APIs return no releases or tags. A moving branch snapshot does not satisfy this collection's pinned-release rule. SDL3_image includes NanoSVG code at its own pinned release and records that shared family.

name: gegl
reason: The installed GEGL 0.4.72 gegl:load API rendered the valid SVG, but it reported no native .svg loader and fell back to gegl:magick-load. The pinned GEGL source shows that operation spawns ImageMagick convert on the filename and reloads a temporary PNG. This installed path does not itself parse SVG as a library API; ImageMagick already has a direct verified row. GEGL svg-load source exists but that plugin was not installed or exercised.
